# Canonical source faces: homothetic fibers and correlated affine-rate reservoirs

This records additional exact structure after the same-separator plane reduction. It retains the original physical cap law and source weights. It neither contracts the source certificate nor identifies a whole-fiber affine-majorant measure with a geometric active-cell measure.

Dependencies: `candidate c106b596b70bfd05` and its independent audit; the complete marked-homothety equality theorem in `candidate 5811f0ad1132ce56`; the strict inclusion argument in `candidate ce31fbbf06cede9c`; and `candidate dbf59e16706aadc7`.

## 1. Exact pointed homothety on every occupied source face

At a fixed actual attained positive-parameter minimum, let B be the convex hull of the ORIGINAL positive source bases. Let Q be one maximal face of B whose relative interior contains an integer point q. Write

    P_Q = Q intersect Z^n,
    Y_p=(p,y_p), l_p=L(Y_p)>0, F_p=E_(K_p)(y_p)^(1/d).

Every p in P_Q is an actual proper deepest base by deepest interpolation. There are affine functions y:aff Q -> R^d and l:aff Q -> R, with l>0 on Q, and one pointed convex body D containing zero in its interior, such that

    y(p)=y_p, l(p)=l_p, K_p=y_p+l_p D   (p in P_Q).       (1)

Proof. Choose a strictly positive representation of q using ALL bases of the finite set P_Q. Such a representation exists because q is relatively interior. The actual deepest quantile argument gives equality of the concave buffered radius at this combination. For N=d+1 that radius is

    f_p=M^(-1/N) l_p^(1/N) F_p^(d/N).

Concavity gives the chain

    f_q >= M^(-1/N)(sum theta_p l_p)^(1/N)
                           (sum theta_p F_p)^(d/N)
        >= sum theta_p f_p = f_q.

Every term is positive. Equality and strict monotonicity force l_q=sum theta_p l_p and F_q=sum theta_p F_p. Equality in the positive weighted geometric mean forces F_p/l_p to be independent of p. Put Kbar=sum theta_p K_p and ybar=sum theta_p y_p=y_q. Then

    F_q >= E_Kbar(ybar)^(1/d) >= sum theta_p F_p = F_q.

Strict energy monotonicity under a proper convex inclusion forces K_q=Kbar. The complete joint energy equality theorem makes all pointed K_p-y_p positively homothetic with scale proportional to F_p. Since F_p/l_p is constant, they equal l_p D for one D.

For affine dependence, fix the strictly positive coefficients theta above. If (a_p) is any real affine dependence of the finite bases, then theta+t a and theta-t a remain positive anchored representations of q for small t. Each representation has averaged mark Y_q and averaged L-value l_q. Subtracting the two equations gives sum a_p y_p=0 and sum a_p l_p=0. Therefore both data sets extend affinely to aff Q. Positivity on Q follows from positivity at its vertices. This proves (1).

The body T_Q=conv union_(p in P_Q)({p} times K_p) consequently has real fibers

    (T_Q)_z=y(z)+l(z) D,     z in Q.                    (2)

This is a subbody of the original canonical C. Equation (2) does not claim that the original C has no extra points at UNSAMPLED real bases in Q. At the sampled bases p in P_Q the bodies coincide exactly by (1).

## 2. The canonical touching plane has a common pointed denominator

Let A_Q be the chosen affine sampled majorant touching all original positive sources on Q, and hence touching the interpolated marks throughout P_Q. After the canonical replacement it is a global majorant. Let c be its continuous gradient. Then

    A_Q(p,y_p+l_p xi)=l_p(1+c dot xi)   (p in P_Q, xi in D).   (3)

Indeed A_Q(Y_p)=l_p and the continuous slope is c. Thus a(xi)=1+c dot xi is the SAME positive affine denominator on the common pointed body at this fixed stage. If it tends to a nonnegative denominator in a selected sequence, its zero-face fibers over this source face are pointed homothetic as well.

The corresponding global active cell contains Y_q at height l_q. Under the uniform source-value lower bound, its maximum affine height is uniformly bounded below. Hence its GLOBAL exponential start parameter is zero. The cell in another fixed target fiber can still have maximum height tending to zero at a positive exponential rate. Convex interpolation from the global anchor changes the base coordinate, so the global height observation is not a fiberwise nesting proof.

## 3. Exact correlation of whole-majorant reciprocal laws

Now pass along an actual selected sequence j with the source face Q and its lattice points fixed. Suppose y_(p,j)->y_p and l_(p,j)->l_p>0, as supplied after subsequences by the canonical bounds. Fix p0 in P_Q. Define the physical affine map between the two sampled fibers

    T_(p,j)(X)=y_(p,j)+(l_(p,j)/l_(p0,j))(X-y_(p0,j)),
    a_(p,j)=l_(p,j)/l_(p0,j).

It maps the ENTIRE fiber K_(p0,j) onto K_(p,j). Formula (3) gives

    A_(Q,j)(p,T_(p,j)X)=a_(p,j) A_(Q,j)(p0,X).

For the whole-majorant reciprocal measures

    dnu^A_(p,j)=dX/[M_j A_(Q,j)(p,X)] on K_(p,j),

change of variables therefore yields EXACTLY

    nu^A_(p,j)=a_(p,j)^(d-1) (T_(p,j))_# nu^A_(p0,j).   (4)

Use the common actual logarithmic scale lambda_j and retain the rate

    r^A_j=(-lambda_j log A_(Q,j))_+.

Under T_(p,j), the untruncated rate shifts by -lambda_j log a_(p,j). The factors a_(p,j) stay bounded above and away from zero, so this shift converges uniformly to zero. Reciprocal masses are uniformly bounded because A_(Q,j)>=L_j on sampled fibers. Thus every simultaneous weak limit of these measures with the rate retained obeys, on POSITIVE rates,

    nuhat^A_p=a_p^(d-1)(T_p,id)_# nuhat^A_p0.             (5)

The same statement holds for positive-rate tails. This is an exact correlation between all source-face reservoirs; they cannot be assigned independent rate distributions. It is obtained using the actual stage-by-stage homothetic fibers and common normalization, not a guessed common limiting radial lift.

## 4. Comparison with the actual minimum has a limited but valid order

Let V_j=min_l A_(l,j) be the reduced actual parameter. For each chosen majorant A=A_(Q,j), on every sampled fiber

    0<V_j<=A,
    r^V_j>=r^A_j.

For every nonnegative physical test phi and nonnegative nondecreasing rate test psi,

    integral phi psi(r^V_j) dX/(M_j V_j)
       >= integral phi psi(r^A_j) dX/(M_j A).            (6)

The inequality is pointwise before integration. Passing against continuous such tests with positive-rate support, then monotone approximation, gives the corresponding physical measure order of positive-rate tails. At a threshold where a weak-limit atom could matter one uses the appropriate open or closed approximation; the canonical no-positive-inverse-rate-atom theorem removes this distinction for its densities.

Equation (6) does NOT identify the affine reservoir with the actual A-active cell. It also does not license differentiating tail domination to obtain domination of conditional rate densities. Nor can the reservoirs for different majorants be added: 1/V=max_l 1/A_l, not their sum. Their useful new feature here is the exact inter-base correlation (5) on the source face.

## 5. A uniform source-hull exclusion for the SAME cap law

Let B be the full original positive-source hull. At every surviving proper deepest source base, the actual original weighted-base depth exceeds the common critical cap mass by a uniform g0>0. For any limiting positive-parallel cap with continuous normal t e, and any global majorant

    A=a+alpha dot z+c e dot X, c>0,

write

    margin_H=(t/c) A+ell_H(z).

The actual cap-volume argument proves ell_H(p)<=-t g0/A_sec at EVERY original surviving source base, including cross-source cap/plane pairs. Since ell_H is affine, the SAME uniform bound holds throughout their convex hull:

    ell_H(z)<=-t g0/A_sec   (z in B).                   (7)

Therefore all such caps strictly miss the A=0 face over B. More generally they miss its positive affine levels A/c<g0/A_sec. The constants come from original d-volume and remain unchanged by the plane reduction.

This has an exact feasibility consequence: a nonzero omitted positive-parallel rate incidence must have its base outside B. It is not merely away from the plane's own anchor. Conversely a rate component supported over B has no omitted inside incidence for this direction. The unchanged global inequality may then count all its actual captures whenever that support restriction is legitimately obtained; (7) does not itself permit conditioning the separator by the indicator of B.

## 6. What the combined constraints do and do not settle

The constraints retained simultaneously are: at most k(P) actual planes with distinct-parity deepest anchors; one original physical separator and cap law; exact pointed homothety and affine source data over each occupied source face; correlated whole-majorant rate reservoirs there; and uniform exclusion of inside cap incidences throughout the original source hull.

A rate-slice body's positive base support need not lie in B, and its center need not be over B. The geometric active-cell law is not the whole-majorant reciprocal reservoir. Even where an actual affine blow-up exists, a cap can degenerate to a pure-base boundary and retain a fractional trace on a whole fiber. Its actual retained selection cannot be replaced by the limiting closed halfspace indicator.

Thus these results locate the remaining possible failure precisely: off-source-hull rate mass, its compensation in the original full transport moments, and its actual cap selections. They add compatibility constraints to that mass but prove no lower bound for its contribution to v_good. No parameter-only compression or independent cap law has been substituted for the original separator.
